# Blue Team Asset Console

> A browser-based blue-team asset visibility console for reviewing defensive coverage across laptops, servers, and firewalls.

## Pages

- [Blue team asset dashboard](/)
- [Frontend documentation](/README.md)

## Capabilities

- Review protected assets and monitored coverage.
- Filter assets by type, status, hostname, owner, and IP address.
- Register a laptop, server, or firewall asset.
- Open an asset profile to inspect defensive metadata.

## Data and scope

The dashboard reads the existing JSON records in the `asset1` directory and keeps newly registered browser-session records in local storage. The Python CLI remains unchanged and is the source of truth for the existing project flow.
